{
 "path": ".openclaw/tmp/task-9415cb03.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    ones = [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,x in enumerate(row) if x == 1]
    if len(ones) >= 2:
        # Draw diagonal from upper-left marker to lower-right marker, including both.
        (r1,c1),(r2,c2) = sorted(ones)[:2]
        dr = 1 if r2 >= r1 else -1
        dc = 1 if c2 >= c1 else -1
        for k in range(min(abs(r2-r1), abs(c2-c1)) + 1):
            r,c = r1 + dr*k, c1 + dc*k
            if grid[r][c] in (1,4): out[r][c] = 1
    return out
"
